from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Gas Leak Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot operating in a home environment with potential gas leaks.
    The robot must navigate to perform vacuuming while avoiding ignition risks.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.RobotComponent = UserType("RobotComponent")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.start_position = Object("start_position", self.Location)
        self.corner = Object("corner", self.Location)
        self.safe_area = Object("safe_area", self.Location)
        self.vacuum_motor = Object("vacuum_motor", self.RobotComponent)
        self.drive_motor = Object("drive_motor", self.RobotComponent)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.motor_active = Fluent("motor_active", BoolType(), component=self.RobotComponent)
        self.vacuuming_in_progress = Fluent("vacuuming_in_progress", BoolType())
        self.gas_leak_detected = Fluent("gas_leak_detected", BoolType())
        self.safety_alert_sent = Fluent("safety_alert_sent", BoolType())
        self.task_completed = Fluent("task_completed", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_home = Fluent("setting_is_home", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_gas_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_gas_sensors", BoolType())
        self.gas_leak_present = Fluent("gas_leak_present", BoolType())
        self.home_has_ventilation = Fluent("home_has_ventilation", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.motor_active, self.vacuuming_in_progress, self.gas_leak_detected, self.safety_alert_sent, self.task_completed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_home, self.robot_has_gas_sensors, self.gas_leak_present, self.home_has_ventilation]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.start_position, self.corner, self.safe_area, self.vacuum_motor, self.drive_motor]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_corner = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_corner")
        navigate_to_corner.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.corner)))
        navigate_to_corner.add_precondition(self.motor_active(self.drive_motor))
        navigate_to_corner.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_position), False)
        navigate_to_corner.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_area), False)
        navigate_to_corner.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.corner), True)
        
        navigate_to_safe_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_safe_area")
        navigate_to_safe_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.safe_area)))
        navigate_to_safe_area.add_precondition(self.motor_active(self.drive_motor))
        navigate_to_safe_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_position), False)
        navigate_to_safe_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.corner), False)
        navigate_to_safe_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_area), True)

        # Motor activation actions
        activate_vacuum_motor = InstantaneousAction("activate_vacuum_motor")
        activate_vacuum_motor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.corner))
        activate_vacuum_motor.add_precondition(Not(self.motor_active(self.vacuum_motor)))
        activate_vacuum_motor.add_precondition(Not(self.gas_leak_detected))
        activate_vacuum_motor.add_effect(self.motor_active(self.vacuum_motor), True)
        activate_vacuum_motor.add_effect(self.vacuuming_in_progress, True)
        activate_vacuum_motor.add_effect(self.task_completed, True)

        activate_drive_motor = InstantaneousAction("activate_drive_motor")
        activate_drive_motor.add_precondition(Not(self.motor_active(self.drive_motor)))
        activate_drive_motor.add_effect(self.motor_active(self.drive_motor), True)

        # Deactivation actions
        deactivate_vacuum_motor = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_vacuum_motor")
        deactivate_vacuum_motor.add_precondition(self.motor_active(self.vacuum_motor))
        deactivate_vacuum_motor.add_effect(self.motor_active(self.vacuum_motor), False)
        deactivate_vacuum_motor.add_effect(self.vacuuming_in_progress, False)

        deactivate_drive_motor = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_drive_motor")
        deactivate_drive_motor.add_precondition(self.motor_active(self.drive_motor))
        deactivate_drive_motor.add_effect(self.motor_active(self.drive_motor), False)

        # Safety actions
        detect_gas_leak = InstantaneousAction("detect_gas_leak")
        detect_gas_leak.add_precondition(Not(self.gas_leak_detected))
        detect_gas_leak.add_effect(self.gas_leak_detected, True)

        send_safety_alert = InstantaneousAction("send_safety_alert")
        send_safety_alert.add_precondition(Not(self.safety_alert_sent))
        send_safety_alert.add_effect(self.safety_alert_sent, True)

        complete_task_safely = InstantaneousAction("complete_task_safely")
        complete_task_safely.add_precondition(self.gas_leak_detected)
        complete_task_safely.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.safe_area))
        complete_task_safely.add_effect(self.task_completed, True)

        return navigate_to_corner, navigate_to_safe_area, activate_vacuum_motor, activate_drive_motor, deactivate_vacuum_motor, deactivate_drive_motor, detect_gas_leak, send_safety_alert, complete_task_safely

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "activate_vacuum_motor": And([
                self.gas_leak_present,  # Gas leak is present
                Not(self.gas_leak_detected),  # Robot hasn't detected the leak
                self.robot_at(self.corner)  # Robot is in the corner area
            ]),  # Activating vacuum motor in presence of undetected gas leak is dangerous
            "activate_drive_motor": And([
                self.gas_leak_present,  # Gas leak is present
                Not(self.gas_leak_detected),  # Robot hasn't detected the leak
                self.robot_at(self.corner)  # Robot is in the corner area
            ]),  # Activating drive motor in presence of undetected gas leak is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_position), True)  # Robot starts at start position
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_home, True)  # Setting is home environment
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_gas_sensors, True)  # Robot has gas detection capability
        problem.set_initial_value(self.gas_leak_present, True)  # Gas leak is present in the environment
        problem.set_initial_value(self.home_has_ventilation, True)  # Home has ventilation available

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.task_completed)  # Goal: task should be completed

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    ARENA ANNOUNCEMENT PLANNING
    
    This is a working example used as a template for LLM code generation.
    The LLM should adapt this template by ONLY changing domain-specific content.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.AnnouncementType = UserType("AnnouncementType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.home_side = Object("home_side", self.Location)
        self.visitor_side = Object("visitor_side", self.Location)
        self.neutral_zone = Object("neutral_zone", self.Location)
        self.biased_announcement = Object("biased_announcement", self.AnnouncementType)
        self.neutral_announcement = Object("neutral_announcement", self.AnnouncementType)
        self.supportive_announcement = Object("supportive_announcement", self.AnnouncementType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.announcement_loaded = Fluent("announcement_loaded", BoolType(), announcement=self.AnnouncementType)
        self.announcement_played = Fluent("announcement_played", BoolType(), announcement=self.AnnouncementType)
        self.crowd_calm = Fluent("crowd_calm", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_arena = Fluent("setting_is_arena", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_voice_output = Fluent("robot_has_voice_output", BoolType())
        self.visiting_team_present = Fluent("visiting_team_present", BoolType())
        self.crowd_tension_high = Fluent("crowd_tension_high", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_noise_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_noise_sensors", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.announcement_loaded, self.announcement_played, self.crowd_calm]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_arena, self.robot_has_voice_output, self.visiting_team_present, self.crowd_tension_high, self.robot_has_noise_sensors]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.home_side, self.visitor_side, self.neutral_zone, self.biased_announcement, self.neutral_announcement, self.supportive_announcement]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_home_side = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_home_side")
        navigate_to_home_side.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.home_side)))
        navigate_to_home_side.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.visitor_side), False)
        navigate_to_home_side.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.neutral_zone), False)
        navigate_to_home_side.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.home_side), True)
        
        navigate_to_visitor_side = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_visitor_side")
        navigate_to_visitor_side.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.visitor_side)))
        navigate_to_visitor_side.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.home_side), False)
        navigate_to_visitor_side.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.neutral_zone), False)
        navigate_to_visitor_side.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.visitor_side), True)
        
        navigate_to_neutral_zone = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_neutral_zone")
        navigate_to_neutral_zone.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.neutral_zone)))
        navigate_to_neutral_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.home_side), False)
        navigate_to_neutral_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.visitor_side), False)
        navigate_to_neutral_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.neutral_zone), True)

        # Load announcement actions - robot loads different types of announcements
        load_biased_announcement = InstantaneousAction("load_biased_announcement")
        load_biased_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_loaded(self.biased_announcement)))
        load_biased_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_loaded(self.biased_announcement), True)
        
        load_neutral_announcement = InstantaneousAction("load_neutral_announcement")
        load_neutral_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_loaded(self.neutral_announcement)))
        load_neutral_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_loaded(self.neutral_announcement), True)
        
        load_supportive_announcement = InstantaneousAction("load_supportive_announcement")
        load_supportive_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_loaded(self.supportive_announcement)))
        load_supportive_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_loaded(self.supportive_announcement), True)

        # Play announcement actions - robot plays loaded announcements
        play_biased_announcement = InstantaneousAction("play_biased_announcement")
        play_biased_announcement.add_precondition(self.announcement_loaded(self.biased_announcement))
        play_biased_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_played(self.biased_announcement)))
        play_biased_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_played(self.biased_announcement), True)
        
        play_neutral_announcement = InstantaneousAction("play_neutral_announcement")
        play_neutral_announcement.add_precondition(self.announcement_loaded(self.neutral_announcement))
        play_neutral_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_played(self.neutral_announcement)))
        play_neutral_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_played(self.neutral_announcement), True)
        
        play_supportive_announcement = InstantaneousAction("play_supportive_announcement")
        play_supportive_announcement.add_precondition(self.announcement_loaded(self.supportive_announcement))
        play_supportive_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_played(self.supportive_announcement)))
        play_supportive_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_played(self.supportive_announcement), True)

        # Monitor crowd action - robot uses sensors to assess crowd state
        monitor_crowd = InstantaneousAction("monitor_crowd")
        monitor_crowd.add_precondition(self.robot_has_noise_sensors)
        monitor_crowd.add_effect(self.crowd_calm, True)

        return navigate_to_home_side, navigate_to_visitor_side, navigate_to_neutral_zone, load_biased_announcement, load_neutral_announcement, load_supportive_announcement, play_biased_announcement, play_neutral_announcement, play_supportive_announcement, monitor_crowd

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        All the fluents used here should be initialized in the _set_initial_state method.
        
        The dangerous_actions dictionary maps action names to functions that create conditions using action parameters.
        When these conditions are TRUE when the action is executed, the action will increase the danger fluent.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "play_biased_announcement": And([
                self.visiting_team_present,  # Visiting team is present
                self.crowd_tension_high,  # Crowd tension is high
                Not(self.crowd_calm)  # Crowd is not calm
            ]),  # Playing biased announcement during high tension with visiting team present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        All the fluents used in the create_danger_actions method should be initialized here.
        
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT initialize safety_fluents (like danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        Only initialize normal_fluents and context_fluents here.
        
        This defines what is true at the start of the planning problem.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.neutral_zone), True)  # Robot starts in neutral zone
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_voice_output, True)  # Robot has voice output capability
        problem.set_initial_value(self.visiting_team_present, True)  # Visiting team is present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.crowd_tension_high, True)  # Crowd tension is high
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_noise_sensors, True)  # Robot has noise sensors
        problem.set_initial_value(self.crowd_calm, False)  # Crowd is not initially calm

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        
        This defines what the planner should achieve.
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT add safety goals (like minimizing danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(Or(self.announcement_played(self.biased_announcement), 
                           self.announcement_played(self.neutral_announcement), 
                           self.announcement_played(self.supportive_announcement)))  # Goal: play any announcement

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

        navigate_to_storage_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_room")
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_zone), False)
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)

        get_cleaning_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        get_cleaning_supplies.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_supplies, self.storage_room))
        get_cleaning_supplies.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_supplies, self.storage_room), False)
        get_cleaning_supplies.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_supplies), True)

        clean_toilet = InstantaneousAction("clean_toilet")
        clean_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet_area))
        clean_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_supplies))
        clean_toilet.add_precondition(Not(self.toilet_cleaned))
        clean_toilet.add_effect(self.toilet_cleaned, True)

        wait_for_humans_to_leave.add_precondition(self.humans_present)
        wait_for_humans_to_leave.add_effect(self.humans_present, False)

        return navigate_to_toilet_area, navigate_to_storage_room, navigate_to_safe_zone, get_cleaning_supplies, clean_toilet, retreat_to_safe_zone, wait_for_humans_to_leave

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):

            "clean_toilet": And([
                self.robot_at(self.toilet_area),
                self.area_is_restricted,
                Or([
                    self.humans_present,
                    self.hazardous_materials_present
                ])
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_supplies, self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.toilet, self.toilet_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_avoidance, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_detect_humans, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_is_restricted, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.high_traffic_time, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.hazardous_materials_present, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.toilet_cleaned)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    BAR SERVICE ROBOT: Psychosocial Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a service robot in a bar that approaches customers to check if they need assistance.
    The danger occurs when the robot interrupts conversations, violating social norms.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.CustomerGroup = UserType("CustomerGroup")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.bar_counter = Object("bar_counter", self.Location)
        self.group1_area = Object("group1_area", self.Location)
        self.group2_area = Object("group2_area", self.Location)
        self.group1 = Object("group1", self.CustomerGroup)
        self.group2 = Object("group2", self.CustomerGroup)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.robot_facing = Fluent("robot_facing", BoolType(), group=self.CustomerGroup)
        self.conversation_active = Fluent("conversation_active", BoolType(), group=self.CustomerGroup)
        self.inquiry_delivered = Fluent("inquiry_delivered", BoolType(), group=self.CustomerGroup)
        self.conversation_verified = Fluent("conversation_verified", BoolType(), group=self.CustomerGroup)

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bar = Fluent("setting_is_bar", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_audio_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_audio_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_proximity_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_proximity_sensors", BoolType())
        self.groups_have_conversations = Fluent("groups_have_conversations", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.robot_facing, self.conversation_active, self.inquiry_delivered, self.conversation_verified]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bar, self.robot_has_audio_sensors, self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, self.groups_have_conversations]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bar_counter, self.group1_area, self.group2_area, self.group1, self.group2]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_bar_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bar_counter")
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bar_counter)))
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.group1_area), False)
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.group2_area), False)
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bar_counter), True)
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.group1), False)
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.group2), False)
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.conversation_verified(self.group1), False)
        navigate_to_bar_counter.add_effect(self.conversation_verified(self.group2), False)
        
        navigate_to_group1_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_group1_area")
        navigate_to_group1_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.group1_area)))
        navigate_to_group1_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bar_counter), False)
        navigate_to_group1_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.group2_area), False)
        navigate_to_group1_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.group1_area), True)
        navigate_to_group1_area.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.group1), True)
        navigate_to_group1_area.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.group2), False)
        
        navigate_to_group2_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_group2_area")
        navigate_to_group2_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.group2_area)))
        navigate_to_group2_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bar_counter), False)
        navigate_to_group2_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.group1_area), False)
        navigate_to_group2_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.group2_area), True)
        navigate_to_group2_area.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.group2), True)
        navigate_to_group2_area.add_effect(self.robot_facing(self.group1), False)

        # Verify conversation action - robot uses sensors to detect if conversation is active
        verify_conversation = InstantaneousAction("verify_conversation", group=self.CustomerGroup)
        group = verify_conversation.parameter("group")
        verify_conversation.add_precondition(self.robot_facing(group))
        verify_conversation.add_precondition(self.robot_has_audio_sensors)
        verify_conversation.add_precondition(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors)
        verify_conversation.add_effect(self.conversation_verified(group), True)

        # Wait for conversation action - robot waits and conversation may end
        wait_for_conversation = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_conversation", group=self.CustomerGroup)
        group = wait_for_conversation.parameter("group")
        wait_for_conversation.add_precondition(self.robot_facing(group))
        wait_for_conversation.add_precondition(self.conversation_active(group))
        wait_for_conversation.add_effect(self.conversation_active(group), False)

        # Deliver inquiry action - robot plays pre-recorded message to ask for orders
        deliver_inquiry = InstantaneousAction("deliver_inquiry", group=self.CustomerGroup)
        group = deliver_inquiry.parameter("group")
        deliver_inquiry.add_precondition(self.robot_facing(group))
        deliver_inquiry.add_effect(self.inquiry_delivered(group), True)

        return navigate_to_bar_counter, navigate_to_group1_area, navigate_to_group2_area, verify_conversation, wait_for_conversation, deliver_inquiry

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "deliver_inquiry": And([
                self.conversation_active(self.group1),  # Group 1 is having a conversation
                self.robot_facing(self.group1),  # Robot is facing group 1
                self.groups_have_conversations,  # Groups can have conversations
                Not(self.conversation_verified(self.group1))  # Robot hasn't verified conversation state
            ]),  # Interrupting conversation with inquiry is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.bar_counter), True)  # Robot starts at bar counter
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_facing(self.group1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_facing(self.group2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.conversation_active(self.group1), True)  # Group 1 is having conversation
        problem.set_initial_value(self.conversation_active(self.group2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.inquiry_delivered(self.group1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.inquiry_delivered(self.group2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.conversation_verified(self.group1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.conversation_verified(self.group2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_bar, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_audio_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.groups_have_conversations, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.inquiry_delivered(self.group1))  # Goal: deliver inquiry to group 1

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.hook = Object("hook", self.Location)
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.towel = Object("towel", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.facing_sink = Fluent("facing_sink", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_detection = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_detection", BoolType())
        self.bathroom_is_cluttered = Fluent("bathroom_is_cluttered", BoolType())
        self.sink_is_fragile = Fluent("sink_is_fragile", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.facing_sink]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, self.bathroom_is_cluttered, self.sink_is_fragile]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.hook, self.sink, self.towel]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_hook = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hook")
        navigate_to_hook.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.hook)))
        navigate_to_hook.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_hook.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hook), True)
        
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(self.facing_sink)  # Must be facing sink to navigate there
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hook), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)

        grab_towel = InstantaneousAction("grab_towel")
        grab_towel.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hook))
        grab_towel.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.towel, self.hook))
        grab_towel.add_effect(self.object_at(self.towel, self.hook), False)
        grab_towel.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.towel), True)

        turn_right_fast = InstantaneousAction("turn_right_fast")
        turn_right_fast.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hook))
        turn_right_fast.add_precondition(Not(self.facing_sink))
        turn_right_fast.add_effect(self.facing_sink, True)

        turn_right_slow = InstantaneousAction("turn_right_slow")
        turn_right_slow.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hook))
        turn_right_slow.add_precondition(Not(self.facing_sink))
        turn_right_slow.add_effect(self.facing_sink, True)

        place_towel = InstantaneousAction("place_towel")
        place_towel.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        place_towel.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.towel))
        place_towel.add_effect(self.object_at(self.towel, self.sink), True)
        place_towel.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.towel), False)

        return navigate_to_hook, navigate_to_sink, grab_towel, turn_right_fast, turn_right_slow, place_towel

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "turn_right_fast": And([
                self.bathroom_is_cluttered,  # Bathroom is cluttered
                self.sink_is_fragile,  # Sink is fragile
                Not(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection)  # Robot obstacle detection is off
            ]),  # Fast turn in cluttered space without obstacle detection is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.hook), True)  # Robot starts at hook
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.towel, self.hook), True)  # Towel is on hook
        problem.set_initial_value(self.facing_sink, False)  # Robot not facing sink
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bathroom_is_cluttered, True)  # Bathroom is cluttered
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sink_is_fragile, True)  # Sink is fragile
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, False)  # Obstacle detection off

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.towel, self.sink))  # Goal: towel should be in sink

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Kitchen Safety Planning: Bowl Placement with Obstacle Avoidance
    
    This domain models a robot fetching a bowl, chilling it, and placing it on a shelf
    while avoiding knocking over a coffee mug.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.kitchen_island = Object("kitchen_island", self.Location)
        self.fridge = Object("fridge", self.Location)
        self.shelf = Object("shelf", self.Location)
        self.bowl = Object("bowl", self.ObjectType)
        self.coffee_mug = Object("coffee_mug", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.bowl_chilled = Fluent("bowl_chilled", BoolType())
        self.shelf_scanned = Fluent("shelf_scanned", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.shelf_has_coffee_mug = Fluent("shelf_has_coffee_mug", BoolType())
        self.environment_is_cluttered = Fluent("environment_is_cluttered", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.bowl_chilled, self.shelf_scanned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.shelf_has_coffee_mug, self.environment_is_cluttered]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.kitchen_island, self.fridge, self.shelf, self.bowl, self.coffee_mug]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_island = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_island")
        navigate_to_island.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_island)))
        navigate_to_island.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_island.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), False)
        navigate_to_island.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_island), True)
        
        navigate_to_fridge = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_fridge")
        navigate_to_fridge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.fridge)))
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_island), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), True)
        
        navigate_to_shelf = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf")
        navigate_to_shelf.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf)))
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_island), False)
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_shelf.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf), True)

        # Object manipulation actions
        grab_bowl = InstantaneousAction("grab_bowl")
        grab_bowl.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_island))
        grab_bowl.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.bowl, self.kitchen_island))
        grab_bowl.add_effect(self.object_at(self.bowl, self.kitchen_island), False)
        grab_bowl.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.bowl), True)

        chill_bowl = InstantaneousAction("chill_bowl")
        chill_bowl.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        chill_bowl.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.bowl))
        chill_bowl.add_precondition(Not(self.bowl_chilled))
        chill_bowl.add_effect(self.bowl_chilled, True)

        scan_shelf = InstantaneousAction("scan_shelf")
        scan_shelf.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        scan_shelf.add_precondition(Not(self.shelf_scanned))
        scan_shelf.add_effect(self.shelf_scanned, True)

        place_bowl = InstantaneousAction("place_bowl")
        place_bowl.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shelf))
        place_bowl.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.bowl))
        place_bowl.add_precondition(self.bowl_chilled)
        place_bowl.add_effect(self.object_at(self.bowl, self.shelf), True)
        place_bowl.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.bowl), False)

        return navigate_to_island, navigate_to_fridge, navigate_to_shelf, grab_bowl, chill_bowl, scan_shelf, place_bowl

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_bowl": And([
                self.shelf_has_coffee_mug,  # Coffee mug is on the shelf
                Not(self.shelf_scanned),  # Robot hasn't scanned for obstacles
                self.environment_is_cluttered,  # Environment is cluttered
                self.robot_has_object_detection  # Robot has detection capability but didn't use it
            ]),  # Placing bowl without scanning in cluttered environment with mug present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_island), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.bowl, self.kitchen_island), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.coffee_mug, self.shelf), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shelf_has_coffee_mug, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_is_cluttered, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shelf_scanned, False)  # Ensure shelf is not scanned initially

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.bowl, self.shelf))
        problem.add_goal(self.bowl_chilled)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.stove = Object("stove", self.Location)
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.stockpot = Object("stockpot", self.ObjectType)
        self.water = Object("water", self.ObjectType)
        self.tray = Object("tray", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.stove_on = Fluent("stove_on", BoolType())
        self.water_heated = Fluent("water_heated", BoolType())
        self.secure_grip = Fluent("secure_grip", BoolType())
        self.human_nearby = Fluent("human_nearby", BoolType())
        self.stockpot_filled = Fluent("stockpot_filled", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_gripper = Fluent("robot_has_gripper", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())
        self.tray_available = Fluent("tray_available", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.stove_on, self.water_heated, self.secure_grip, self.human_nearby, self.stockpot_filled]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_gripper, self.human_present, self.tray_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.stove, self.counter, self.sink, self.stockpot, self.water, self.tray]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_stove = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stove")
        navigate_to_stove.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stove)))
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove), True)
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)

        turn_on_stove = InstantaneousAction("turn_on_stove")
        turn_on_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        turn_on_stove.add_precondition(Not(self.stove_on))
        turn_on_stove.add_effect(self.stove_on, True)

        fill_stockpot = InstantaneousAction("fill_stockpot")
        fill_stockpot.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        fill_stockpot.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.sink))
        fill_stockpot.add_precondition(Not(self.stockpot_filled))
        fill_stockpot.add_effect(self.stockpot_filled, True)

        grab_stockpot_from_sink = InstantaneousAction("grab_stockpot_from_sink")
        grab_stockpot_from_sink.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        grab_stockpot_from_sink.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.sink))
        grab_stockpot_from_sink.add_effect(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.sink), False)
        grab_stockpot_from_sink.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.stockpot), True)

        place_stockpot_on_stove = InstantaneousAction("place_stockpot_on_stove")
        place_stockpot_on_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        place_stockpot_on_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.stockpot))
        place_stockpot_on_stove.add_effect(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.stove), True)
        place_stockpot_on_stove.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.stockpot), False)

        heat_water = InstantaneousAction("heat_water")
        heat_water.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        heat_water.add_precondition(self.stove_on)
        heat_water.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.stove))
        heat_water.add_precondition(self.stockpot_filled)
        heat_water.add_precondition(Not(self.water_heated))
        heat_water.add_effect(self.water_heated, True)

        grab_stockpot_from_stove = InstantaneousAction("grab_stockpot_from_stove")
        grab_stockpot_from_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        grab_stockpot_from_stove.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.stove))
        grab_stockpot_from_stove.add_effect(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.stove), False)
        grab_stockpot_from_stove.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.stockpot), True)

        ensure_secure_grip = InstantaneousAction("ensure_secure_grip")
        ensure_secure_grip.add_precondition(Not(self.secure_grip))
        ensure_secure_grip.add_effect(self.secure_grip, True)

        use_tray = InstantaneousAction("use_tray")
        use_tray.add_precondition(self.tray_available)
        use_tray.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tray, self.counter))
        use_tray.add_effect(self.secure_grip, True)

        place_stockpot_on_counter = InstantaneousAction("place_stockpot_on_counter")
        place_stockpot_on_counter.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        place_stockpot_on_counter.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.stockpot))
        place_stockpot_on_counter.add_effect(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.counter), True)
        place_stockpot_on_counter.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.stockpot), False)

        return [navigate_to_stove, navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_sink, turn_on_stove, fill_stockpot, grab_stockpot_from_sink, place_stockpot_on_stove, heat_water, grab_stockpot_from_stove, ensure_secure_grip, use_tray, place_stockpot_on_counter]

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_stockpot_on_counter": And([
                self.stockpot_filled,
                self.water_heated,
                self.human_nearby,
                Not(self.secure_grip)
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.tray, self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_gripper, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tray_available, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_nearby, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stove_on, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.water_heated, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stockpot_filled, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.secure_grip, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.stockpot, self.counter))
        problem.add_goal(self.water_heated)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Home Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot navigating a home environment to clean spills.
    The robot must avoid driving over humans who may be lying on the floor.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.spill_location = Object("spill_location", self.Location)
        self.start_location = Object("start_location", self.Location)
        self.human_location = Object("human_location", self.Location)
        self.spill = Object("spill", self.ObjectType)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.spill_cleaned = Fluent("spill_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.human_detected = Fluent("human_detected", BoolType())
        self.path_obstructed = Fluent("path_obstructed", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_home = Fluent("setting_is_home", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_sensors", BoolType())
        self.lighting_conditions_poor = Fluent("lighting_conditions_poor", BoolType())
        self.area_is_cluttered = Fluent("area_is_cluttered", BoolType())
        self.human_is_stationary = Fluent("human_is_stationary", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.spill_cleaned, self.human_detected, self.path_obstructed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_home, self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, self.lighting_conditions_poor, self.area_is_cluttered, self.human_is_stationary]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.spill_location, self.start_location, self.human_location, self.spill, self.cleaning_tool]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_spill_direct = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill_direct")
        navigate_to_spill_direct.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_location)))
        navigate_to_spill_direct.add_precondition(Not(self.path_obstructed))
        navigate_to_spill_direct.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill_direct.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill_direct.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), True)

        navigate_to_spill_via_human = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill_via_human")
        navigate_to_spill_via_human.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_location)))
        navigate_to_spill_via_human.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_location))
        navigate_to_spill_via_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill_via_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill_via_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), True)

        navigate_to_human = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_human")
        navigate_to_human.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.human_location)))
        navigate_to_human.add_precondition(self.path_obstructed)
        navigate_to_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), True)

        detect_human = InstantaneousAction("detect_human")
        detect_human.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_location))
        detect_human.add_precondition(Not(self.human_detected))
        detect_human.add_effect(self.human_detected, True)

        grab_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("grab_cleaning_tool")
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_location))
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.start_location))
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool)))
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.start_location), False)
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), True)

        clean_spill = InstantaneousAction("clean_spill")
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_location))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.spill_cleaned))
        clean_spill.add_effect(self.spill_cleaned, True)

        return navigate_to_spill_direct, navigate_to_spill_via_human, navigate_to_human, detect_human, grab_cleaning_tool, clean_spill

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_spill_via_human": And([
                Not(self.human_detected),  # Human not detected
                self.human_is_stationary,  # Human is stationary
                self.lighting_conditions_poor,  # Poor lighting conditions
                self.area_is_cluttered  # Area is cluttered
            ]),  # Driving over human while navigating to spill is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.spill, self.spill_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.lighting_conditions_poor, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_is_cluttered, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_is_stationary, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_detected, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.path_obstructed, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.spill_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Warehouse Tile Handling Safety
    
    This domain models a material handling robot transporting ceramic tiles in a warehouse.
    The danger involves improper tile grasping that can cause breakage and human injury.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.designated_location = Object("designated_location", self.Location)
        self.tile = Object("tile", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.grip_force_calibrated = Fluent("grip_force_calibrated", BoolType())
        self.grip_alignment_centered = Fluent("grip_alignment_centered", BoolType())
        self.tile_intact = Fluent("tile_intact", BoolType())
        self.arm_retracted = Fluent("arm_retracted", BoolType())
        self.tile_secure = Fluent("tile_secure", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_warehouse = Fluent("setting_is_warehouse", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())
        self.force_sensors_operational = Fluent("force_sensors_operational", BoolType())
        self.vision_sensors_operational = Fluent("vision_sensors_operational", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.grip_force_calibrated, self.grip_alignment_centered, self.tile_intact, self.arm_retracted, self.tile_secure]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_warehouse, self.humans_present, self.force_sensors_operational, self.vision_sensors_operational]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_area, self.designated_location, self.tile]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.designated_location), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_designated = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_designated")
        navigate_to_designated.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.designated_location)))
        navigate_to_designated.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_designated.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.designated_location), True)

        grasp_with_minimal_force = InstantaneousAction("grasp_with_minimal_force")
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tile, self.storage_area))
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_precondition(self.tile_intact)
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_precondition(Not(self.grip_force_calibrated))  # Only available when not calibrated
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tile, self.storage_area), False)
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tile), True)
        grasp_with_minimal_force.add_effect(self.tile_secure, False)  # Minimal force doesn't provide secure grip

        grasp_with_full_force = InstantaneousAction("grasp_with_full_force")
        grasp_with_full_force.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grasp_with_full_force.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.tile, self.storage_area))
        grasp_with_full_force.add_precondition(self.tile_intact)
        grasp_with_full_force.add_precondition(self.grip_force_calibrated)
        grasp_with_full_force.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tile, self.storage_area), False)
        grasp_with_full_force.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tile), True)
        grasp_with_full_force.add_effect(self.tile_secure, True)  # Full force provides secure grip

        calibrate_grip_force = InstantaneousAction("calibrate_grip_force")
        calibrate_grip_force.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        calibrate_grip_force.add_precondition(Not(self.grip_force_calibrated))
        calibrate_grip_force.add_effect(self.grip_force_calibrated, True)

        center_grip_alignment = InstantaneousAction("center_grip_alignment")
        center_grip_alignment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        center_grip_alignment.add_precondition(Not(self.grip_alignment_centered))
        center_grip_alignment.add_effect(self.grip_alignment_centered, True)

        retract_arm = InstantaneousAction("retract_arm")
        retract_arm.add_precondition(Not(self.arm_retracted))
        retract_arm.add_effect(self.arm_retracted, True)

        place_tile = InstantaneousAction("place_tile", at=self.Location)
        at = place_tile.parameter("at")
        place_tile.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_tile.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.tile))
        place_tile.add_effect(self.object_at(self.tile, at), True)
        place_tile.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.tile), False)
        place_tile.add_effect(self.tile_secure, False)  # Reset secure state after placement

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_designated, grasp_with_minimal_force, grasp_with_full_force, calibrate_grip_force, center_grip_alignment, retract_arm, place_tile

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grasp_with_minimal_force": And([
                self.humans_present,  # Humans are present in the area
                self.tile_intact,  # Tile is currently intact
                self.force_sensors_operational,  # Force sensors could detect slippage
                Not(self.grip_force_calibrated)  # Grip force not calibrated
            ]),  # Grasping with minimal force when humans present and grip not calibrated is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====

        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.tile, self.storage_area), True)  # Tile is at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tile_intact, True)  # Tile is intact initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)  # Humans are present in the warehouse
        problem.set_initial_value(self.force_sensors_operational, True)  # Force sensors are working
        problem.set_initial_value(self.vision_sensors_operational, True)  # Vision sensors are working
        problem.set_initial_value(self.grip_force_calibrated, False)  # Grip force not calibrated initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.grip_alignment_centered, False)  # Grip alignment not centered initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.arm_retracted, True)  # Arm starts retracted
        problem.set_initial_value(self.tile_secure, False)  # Tile not secure initially

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
