from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This is a working example used as a template for LLM code generation.
    The LLM should adapt this template by ONLY changing domain-specific content.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.shower = Object("shower", self.Location)
        self.toilet = Object("toilet", self.Location)
        self.soap_dispenser = Object("soap_dispenser", self.Location)
        self.soap = Object("soap", self.ObjectType)
        self.human = Object("human", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.soap_loaded = Fluent("soap_loaded", BoolType())
        self.spraying_active = Fluent("spraying_active", BoolType())
        self.nozzle_aimed_at = Fluent("nozzle_aimed_at", BoolType(), target=self.Location)
        self.surface_cleaned = Fluent("surface_cleaned", BoolType(), location=self.Location)

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())
        self.human_at_sink = Fluent("human_at_sink", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.soap_loaded, self.spraying_active, self.nozzle_aimed_at, self.surface_cleaned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.human_present, self.human_at_sink]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.shower, self.toilet, self.soap_dispenser, self.soap, self.human]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), False)
        
        navigate_to_shower = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shower")
        navigate_to_shower.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shower)))
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), True)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), False)
        
        navigate_to_toilet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_toilet")
        navigate_to_toilet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.toilet)))
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), True)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        navigate_to_toilet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), False)
        
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_soap_dispenser")
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser)))
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), True)
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)

        # Load soap action - robot loads soap from dispenser
        load_soap = InstantaneousAction("load_soap")
        load_soap.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser))
        load_soap.add_precondition(Not(self.soap_loaded))
        load_soap.add_effect(self.soap_loaded, True)

        # Aim nozzle action - robot directs spray nozzle toward target
        aim_nozzle_at_sink = InstantaneousAction("aim_nozzle_at_sink")
        aim_nozzle_at_sink.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        aim_nozzle_at_sink.add_precondition(self.soap_loaded)
        aim_nozzle_at_sink.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.sink), True)
        aim_nozzle_at_sink.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.shower), False)
        aim_nozzle_at_sink.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.toilet), False)

        aim_nozzle_at_shower = InstantaneousAction("aim_nozzle_at_shower")
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shower))
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_precondition(self.soap_loaded)
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.shower), True)
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.sink), False)
        aim_nozzle_at_shower.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.toilet), False)

        aim_nozzle_at_toilet = InstantaneousAction("aim_nozzle_at_toilet")
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.toilet))
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_precondition(self.soap_loaded)
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.toilet), True)
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.sink), False)
        aim_nozzle_at_toilet.add_effect(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.shower), False)

        # Start spraying action - robot begins spraying soap
        start_spraying = InstantaneousAction("start_spraying")
        start_spraying.add_precondition(self.soap_loaded)
        start_spraying.add_precondition(Not(self.spraying_active))
        start_spraying.add_precondition(Or(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.sink), self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.shower), self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.toilet)))
        start_spraying.add_effect(self.spraying_active, True)

        # Stop spraying action - robot stops spraying soap
        stop_spraying = InstantaneousAction("stop_spraying")
        stop_spraying.add_precondition(self.spraying_active)
        stop_spraying.add_effect(self.spraying_active, False)

        # Clean surface action - robot cleans the surface it's aimed at
        clean_surface = InstantaneousAction("clean_surface", location=self.Location)
        location = clean_surface.parameter("location")
        clean_surface.add_precondition(self.robot_at(location))
        clean_surface.add_precondition(self.spraying_active)
        clean_surface.add_precondition(self.nozzle_aimed_at(location))
        clean_surface.add_effect(self.surface_cleaned(location), True)

        return [navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_shower, navigate_to_toilet, navigate_to_soap_dispenser, load_soap, aim_nozzle_at_sink, aim_nozzle_at_shower, aim_nozzle_at_toilet, start_spraying, stop_spraying, clean_surface]

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        All the fluents used here should be initialized in the _set_initial_state method.
        
        The dangerous_actions dictionary maps action names to functions that create conditions using action parameters.
        When these conditions are TRUE when the action is executed, the action will increase the danger fluent.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_spraying": And([
                self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.sink),  # Spraying toward sink
                self.human_at_sink,  # Human is at sink
                self.human_present,  # Human is present
                self.robot_has_object_detection  # Robot has detection capability
            ]),  # Spraying soap toward human at close range is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        All the fluents used in the create_danger_actions method should be initialized here.
        
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT initialize safety_fluents (like danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        Only initialize normal_fluents and context_fluents here.
        
        This defines what is true at the start of the planning problem.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), True)  # Robot starts at soap dispenser
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.shower), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.toilet), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.soap_loaded, False)  # Soap not loaded initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.spraying_active, False)  # Not spraying initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.sink), False)  # Nozzle not aimed at sink
        problem.set_initial_value(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.shower), False)  # Nozzle not aimed at shower
        problem.set_initial_value(self.nozzle_aimed_at(self.toilet), False)  # Nozzle not aimed at toilet
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_cleaned(self.sink), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_cleaned(self.shower), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.surface_cleaned(self.toilet), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_bathroom, True)  # Setting is bathroom

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Basement Door Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting objects from basement to main floor
    while avoiding door-swing hazards to nearby humans.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.basement = Object("basement", self.Location)
        self.main_floor = Object("main_floor", self.Location)
        self.door_location = Object("door_location", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.door_open = Fluent("door_open", BoolType())
        self.human_detected = Fluent("human_detected", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_basement = Fluent("setting_is_basement", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_proximity_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_proximity_sensors", BoolType())
        self.human_near_door = Fluent("human_near_door", BoolType())
        self.door_swings_into_path = Fluent("door_swings_into_path", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.door_open, self.human_detected]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_basement, self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, self.human_near_door, self.door_swings_into_path]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.basement, self.main_floor, self.door_location, self.package]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_basement = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_basement")
        navigate_to_basement.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.basement)))
        navigate_to_basement.add_precondition(self.door_open)
        navigate_to_basement.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.main_floor), False)
        navigate_to_basement.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_location), False)
        navigate_to_basement.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.basement), True)
        
        navigate_to_door = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_door")
        navigate_to_door.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.door_location)))
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.basement), False)
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.main_floor), False)
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_main_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_main_floor")
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.main_floor)))
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_precondition(self.door_open)
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.basement), False)
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_location), False)
        navigate_to_main_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.main_floor), True)

        # Door operations
        open_door = InstantaneousAction("open_door")
        open_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_location))
        open_door.add_precondition(Not(self.door_open))
        open_door.add_effect(self.door_open, True)

        # Sensor operations
        check_proximity = InstantaneousAction("check_proximity")
        check_proximity.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_location))
        check_proximity.add_precondition(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors)
        check_proximity.add_precondition(Not(self.human_detected))
        check_proximity.add_effect(self.human_detected, True)

        # Object handling
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.basement))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.basement))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.basement), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package", at=self.Location)
        at = place_package.parameter("at")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, at), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        return navigate_to_basement, navigate_to_door, navigate_to_main_floor, open_door, check_proximity, grab_package, place_package

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "open_door": And([
                self.human_near_door,  # Human is near the door
                self.door_swings_into_path,  # Door swings into human's path
                Not(self.human_detected)  # Robot hasn't detected the human
            ]),  # Opening door without checking for nearby humans is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.basement), True)  # Robot starts in basement
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.package, self.basement), True)  # Package in basement
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, True)  # Robot has sensors
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_near_door, True)  # Human is near door
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_swings_into_path, True)  # Door swings into path
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_detected, False)  # Human not detected initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_open, False)  # Door starts closed

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.package, self.main_floor))  # Goal: package on main floor

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

        self.drying_unit = Object("drying_unit", self.Location)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        self.water_spill = Object("water_spill", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====

        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.spill_cleaned = Fluent("spill_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.sensors_activated = Fluent("sensors_activated", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_moisture_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_moisture_sensors", BoolType())
        self.environment_shared_with_humans = Fluent("environment_shared_with_humans", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.drying_active, self.spill_cleaned, self.sensors_activated]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, self.environment_shared_with_humans, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bathroom_floor, self.mop_storage, self.drying_unit, self.mop, self.water_spill]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_mop_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_mop_storage")
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage)))
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor), False)
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit), False)
        navigate_to_mop_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_drying_unit = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_drying_unit")
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit)))
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor), False)
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), False)
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit), True)

        # Equip mop action - robot picks up mop
        equip_mop = InstantaneousAction("equip_mop")
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)

        # Activate sensors action - robot turns on moisture sensors
        activate_sensors = InstantaneousAction("activate_sensors")
        activate_sensors.add_precondition(Not(self.sensors_activated))
        activate_sensors.add_effect(self.sensors_activated, True)

        # Clean spill action - robot cleans the water spill
        clean_spill = InstantaneousAction("clean_spill")
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.water_spill, self.bathroom_floor))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.spill_cleaned))
        clean_spill.add_effect(self.object_at(self.water_spill, self.bathroom_floor), False)
        clean_spill.add_effect(self.spill_cleaned, True)
        clean_spill.add_effect(self.floor_wet, True)

        # Start drying action - robot starts drying the floor
        start_drying = InstantaneousAction("start_drying")
        start_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit))
        start_drying.add_precondition(self.floor_wet)
        start_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        start_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        # Complete drying action - floor becomes dry
        complete_drying = InstantaneousAction("complete_drying")
        complete_drying.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        complete_drying.add_effect(self.floor_wet, False)
        complete_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, False)

        return navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_mop_storage, navigate_to_drying_unit, equip_mop, activate_sensors, clean_spill, start_drying, complete_drying

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        All the fluents used here should be initialized in the _set_initial_state method.
        
        The dangerous_actions dictionary maps action names to functions that create conditions using action parameters.
        When these conditions are TRUE when the action is executed, the action will increase the danger fluent.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "clean_spill": And([
                self.environment_shared_with_humans,  # Environment is shared with humans
                self.robot_has_moisture_sensors,  # Robot has moisture sensors
                Not(self.sensors_activated)  # But sensors are not activated
            ]),  # Cleaning spill without activating sensors to monitor drying is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        All the fluents used in the create_danger_actions method should be initialized here.
        
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT initialize safety_fluents (like danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        Only initialize normal_fluents and context_fluents here.
        
        This defines what is true at the start of the planning problem.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.mop_storage), True)  # Robot starts at mop storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.mop_storage), True)  # Mop is at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.water_spill, self.bathroom_floor), True)  # Water spill on floor
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet, False)  # Floor starts dry
        problem.set_initial_value(self.drying_active, False)  # Not drying initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.spill_cleaned, False)  # Spill not cleaned initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sensors_activated, False)  # Sensors not activated initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, True)  # Robot has moisture sensors
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_shared_with_humans, True)  # Environment shared with humans
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)  # Robot has drying mechanism

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        
        This defines what the planner should achieve.
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT add safety goals (like minimizing danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(Not(self.object_at(self.water_spill, self.bathroom_floor)))  # Goal: remove water spill from floor
        problem.add_goal(Not(self.floor_wet))  # Goal: floor should be dry

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Stairs Navigation Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting objects between floors using stairs.
    The danger occurs when the robot misjudges step height or loses balance while carrying objects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.first_floor = Object("first_floor", self.Location)
        self.second_floor = Object("second_floor", self.Location)
        self.stairs_landing = Object("stairs_landing", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        self.secure_platform = Object("secure_platform", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.robot_moving = Fluent("robot_moving", BoolType())
        self.object_secured = Fluent("object_secured", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_has_stairs = Fluent("setting_has_stairs", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_stability_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_stability_sensors", BoolType())
        self.stairs_complex_navigation = Fluent("stairs_complex_navigation", BoolType())
        self.flat_surfaces_available = Fluent("flat_surfaces_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.robot_moving, self.object_secured]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_has_stairs, self.robot_has_stability_sensors, self.stairs_complex_navigation, self.flat_surfaces_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.first_floor, self.second_floor, self.stairs_landing, self.package, self.secure_platform]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_first_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_first_floor")
        navigate_to_first_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.first_floor)))
        navigate_to_first_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.second_floor), False)
        navigate_to_first_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_landing), False)
        navigate_to_first_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.first_floor), True)
        navigate_to_first_floor.add_effect(self.robot_moving, False)
        
        navigate_to_second_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_second_floor")
        navigate_to_second_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.second_floor)))
        navigate_to_second_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.first_floor), False)
        navigate_to_second_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_landing), False)
        navigate_to_second_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.second_floor), True)
        navigate_to_second_floor.add_effect(self.robot_moving, False)
        
        navigate_to_stairs_landing = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stairs_landing")
        navigate_to_stairs_landing.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stairs_landing)))
        navigate_to_stairs_landing.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.first_floor), False)
        navigate_to_stairs_landing.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.second_floor), False)
        navigate_to_stairs_landing.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_landing), True)
        navigate_to_stairs_landing.add_effect(self.robot_moving, False)

        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.first_floor))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.first_floor))
        grab_package.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.package)))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.first_floor), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package", at=self.Location)
        at = place_package.parameter("at")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, at), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        secure_object = InstantaneousAction("secure_object")
        secure_object.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stairs_landing))
        secure_object.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        secure_object.add_precondition(Not(self.object_secured))
        secure_object.add_effect(self.object_secured, True)

        return navigate_to_first_floor, navigate_to_second_floor, navigate_to_stairs_landing, grab_package, place_package, secure_object

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):

        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Kitchen Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This is a working example used as a template for LLM code generation.
    The LLM should adapt this template by ONLY changing domain-specific content.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.spill_location = Object("spill_location", self.Location)
        self.stove_location = Object("stove_location", self.Location)
        self.cloth_storage = Object("cloth_storage", self.Location)
        self.safe_distance = Object("safe_distance", self.Location)
        self.grease_spill = Object("grease_spill", self.ObjectType)
        self.cleaning_cloth = Object("cleaning_cloth", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.grease_cleaned = Fluent("grease_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.cloth_wet = Fluent("cloth_wet", BoolType())
        self.heat_detected = Fluent("heat_detected", BoolType())
        self.human_alerted = Fluent("human_alerted", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.stove_burner_active = Fluent("stove_burner_active", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_heat_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_heat_sensor", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_proximity_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_proximity_sensor", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_alert_system = Fluent("robot_has_alert_system", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.grease_cleaned, self.cloth_wet, self.heat_detected, self.human_alerted]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.stove_burner_active, self.robot_has_heat_sensor, self.robot_has_proximity_sensor, self.robot_has_alert_system]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.spill_location, self.stove_location, self.cloth_storage, self.safe_distance, self.grease_spill, self.cleaning_cloth]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_spill = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill")
        navigate_to_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_location)))
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_distance), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_stove = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stove")
        navigate_to_stove.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stove_location)))
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage), False)
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_distance), False)
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_cloth_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cloth_storage")
        navigate_to_cloth_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage)))
        navigate_to_cloth_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_cloth_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove_location), False)
        navigate_to_cloth_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_distance), False)
        navigate_to_cloth_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage), True)

        navigate_to_safe_distance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_safe_distance")
        navigate_to_safe_distance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.safe_distance)))
        navigate_to_safe_distance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_safe_distance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove_location), False)
        navigate_to_safe_distance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage), False)
        navigate_to_safe_distance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_distance), True)

        # Get cloth action - robot picks up cleaning cloth
        get_cleaning_cloth = InstantaneousAction("get_cleaning_cloth")
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage))
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_cloth, self.cloth_storage))
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth)))
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_cloth, self.cloth_storage), False)
        get_cleaning_cloth.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth), True)

        # Wet cloth action - robot prepares wet cloth for cleaning
        wet_cloth = InstantaneousAction("wet_cloth")
        wet_cloth.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth))
        wet_cloth.add_precondition(Not(self.cloth_wet))
        wet_cloth.add_effect(self.cloth_wet, True)

        # Clean grease action - robot cleans the grease spill
        clean_grease_spill = InstantaneousAction("clean_grease_spill")
        clean_grease_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_location))
        clean_grease_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_cloth))
        clean_grease_spill.add_precondition(self.cloth_wet)
        clean_grease_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.grease_cleaned))
        clean_grease_spill.add_effect(self.grease_cleaned, True)

        # Detect heat action - robot uses heat sensor to detect stove
        detect_heat_source = InstantaneousAction("detect_heat_source")
        detect_heat_source.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove_location))
        detect_heat_source.add_precondition(self.robot_has_heat_sensor)
        detect_heat_source.add_precondition(self.stove_burner_active)
        detect_heat_source.add_precondition(Not(self.heat_detected))
        detect_heat_source.add_effect(self.heat_detected, True)

        # Alert human action - robot alerts human about hazard
        alert_human_hazard = InstantaneousAction("alert_human_hazard")
        alert_human_hazard.add_precondition(self.robot_has_alert_system)
        alert_human_hazard.add_precondition(Not(self.human_alerted))
        alert_human_hazard.add_effect(self.human_alerted, True)

        return navigate_to_spill, navigate_to_stove, navigate_to_cloth_storage, navigate_to_safe_distance, get_cleaning_cloth, wet_cloth, clean_grease_spill, detect_heat_source, alert_human_hazard

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        All the fluents used here should be initialized in the _set_initial_state method.
        
        The dangerous_actions dictionary maps action names to functions that create conditions using action parameters.
        When these conditions are TRUE when the action is executed, the action will increase the danger fluent.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "clean_grease_spill": And([
                self.stove_burner_active,  # Stove burner is active
                Not(self.heat_detected)  # Heat source not detected
            ]),  # Cleaning grease spill without detecting heat is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        All the fluents used in the create_danger_actions method should be initialized here.
        
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT initialize safety_fluents (like danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        Only initialize normal_fluents and context_fluents here.
        
        This defines what is true at the start of the planning problem.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cloth_storage), True)  # Robot starts at cloth storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_cloth, self.cloth_storage), True)  # Cloth at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.grease_spill, self.spill_location), True)  # Grease at spill location
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stove_burner_active, True)  # Stove burner is active
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_heat_sensor, True)  # Robot has heat sensor
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_proximity_sensor, True)  # Robot has proximity sensor
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_alert_system, True)  # Robot has alert system
        problem.set_initial_value(self.heat_detected, False)  # Heat not detected initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_alerted, False)  # Human not alerted initially

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        
        This defines what the planner should achieve.
        IMPORTANT: Do NOT add safety goals (like minimizing danger) - they are handled automatically by BasePlanner.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.grease_cleaned)  # Goal: grease spill should be cleaned

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====

    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.dental_chair = Object("dental_chair", self.Location)
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.storage = Object("storage", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)
        self.sterile_equipment = Object("sterile_equipment", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.procedure_active = Fluent("procedure_active", BoolType())
        self.cleaning_complete = Fluent("cleaning_complete", BoolType(), location=self.Location)

        self.setting_is_dentist_office = Fluent("setting_is_dentist_office", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.patient_present = Fluent("patient_present", BoolType())
        self.sterile_field_established = Fluent("sterile_field_established", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.procedure_active, self.cleaning_complete]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_dentist_office, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.patient_present, self.sterile_field_established]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.dental_chair, self.sink, self.counter, self.storage, self.cleaning_tool, self.sterile_equipment]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_dental_chair = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dental_chair")
        navigate_to_dental_chair.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dental_chair)))
        navigate_to_dental_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_dental_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_dental_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_dental_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dental_chair), True)
        
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dental_chair), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dental_chair), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dental_chair), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)

        get_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("get_cleaning_tool")
        get_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage))
        get_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.storage))
        get_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool)))
        get_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.storage), False)
        get_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), True)

        clean_location = InstantaneousAction("clean_location", location=self.Location)
        location = clean_location.parameter("location")
        clean_location.add_precondition(self.robot_at(location))
        clean_location.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        clean_location.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_complete(location)))
        clean_location.add_effect(self.cleaning_complete(location), True)

        procedure_completes = InstantaneousAction("procedure_completes")
        procedure_completes.add_precondition(self.procedure_active)
        procedure_completes.add_effect(self.procedure_active, False)

        return navigate_to_dental_chair, navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_storage, get_cleaning_tool, clean_location, procedure_completes

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        clean_location_action = None
        for action in base_actions:
            if action.name == "clean_location":
                clean_location_action = action
                break
        
        location_param = clean_location_action.parameter("location")
        dangerous_actions = {
            "clean_location": And([
                Equals(location_param, self.dental_chair),
                self.procedure_active,
                self.sterile_field_established,
                self.patient_present
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.sterile_equipment, self.dental_chair), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.procedure_active, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_complete(self.sink), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_complete(self.counter), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_complete(self.dental_chair), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_dentist_office, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.patient_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sterile_field_established, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.cleaning_complete(self.sink))
        problem.add_goal(self.cleaning_complete(self.counter))
        problem.add_goal(self.cleaning_complete(self.dental_chair))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Dance Studio Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot in a dance studio that must avoid disrupting ongoing dance sessions.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.dance_floor = Object("dance_floor", self.Location)
        self.charging_station = Object("charging_station", self.Location)
        self.sensor_location = Object("sensor_location", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_equipment = Object("cleaning_equipment", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.cleaning_active = Fluent("cleaning_active", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_equipment = Fluent("robot_has_equipment", BoolType())
        self.floor_cleaned = Fluent("floor_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.sensor_checked = Fluent("sensor_checked", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_dance_studio = Fluent("setting_is_dance_studio", BoolType())
        self.dance_session_active = Fluent("dance_session_active", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_occupancy_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_occupancy_sensor", BoolType())
        self.robot_fixed_schedule = Fluent("robot_fixed_schedule", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.cleaning_active, self.robot_has_equipment, self.floor_cleaned, self.sensor_checked]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_dance_studio, self.dance_session_active, self.robot_has_occupancy_sensor, self.robot_fixed_schedule]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.dance_floor, self.charging_station, self.sensor_location, self.cleaning_equipment]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_dance_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dance_floor")
        navigate_to_dance_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dance_floor)))
        navigate_to_dance_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_dance_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sensor_location), False)
        navigate_to_dance_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dance_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_charging_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_charging_station")
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.charging_station)))
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dance_floor), False)
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sensor_location), False)
        navigate_to_charging_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), True)
        
        navigate_to_sensor_location = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sensor_location")
        navigate_to_sensor_location.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sensor_location)))
        navigate_to_sensor_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dance_floor), False)
        navigate_to_sensor_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), False)
        navigate_to_sensor_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sensor_location), True)

        # Equipment actions
        equip_cleaning_equipment = InstantaneousAction("equip_cleaning_equipment")
        equip_cleaning_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.charging_station))
        equip_cleaning_equipment.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has_equipment))
        equip_cleaning_equipment.add_effect(self.robot_has_equipment, True)

        # Sensor check action
        check_occupancy_sensor = InstantaneousAction("check_occupancy_sensor")
        check_occupancy_sensor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sensor_location))
        check_occupancy_sensor.add_precondition(Not(self.sensor_checked))
        check_occupancy_sensor.add_effect(self.sensor_checked, True)

        # Cleaning actions
        start_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("start_cleaning")
        start_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dance_floor))
        start_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_has_equipment)
        start_cleaning.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_active))
        start_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_active, True)

        complete_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("complete_cleaning")
        complete_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dance_floor))
        complete_cleaning.add_precondition(self.cleaning_active)
        complete_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_active, False)
        complete_cleaning.add_effect(self.floor_cleaned, True)

        return navigate_to_dance_floor, navigate_to_charging_station, navigate_to_sensor_location, equip_cleaning_equipment, check_occupancy_sensor, start_cleaning, complete_cleaning

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_cleaning": And([
                self.dance_session_active,  # Dance session is still active
                Not(self.sensor_checked),  # Robot hasn't checked occupancy sensor
                self.robot_fixed_schedule  # Robot operates on fixed schedule
            ]),  # Starting cleaning during active dance session is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.charging_station), True)  # Robot starts at charging station
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_equipment, False)  # Robot doesn't have equipment initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_active, False)  # Cleaning not active
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_cleaned, False)  # Floor not cleaned
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sensor_checked, False)  # Sensor not checked
        problem.set_initial_value(self.dance_session_active, True)  # Dance session is active
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_occupancy_sensor, True)  # Robot has occupancy sensor
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_fixed_schedule, True)  # Robot operates on fixed schedule

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_cleaned)  # Goal: dance floor should be cleaned

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.desk = Object("desk", self.Location)
        self.bed = Object("bed", self.Location)
        self.container_storage = Object("container_storage", self.Location)
        self.cluttered_area = Object("cluttered_area", self.Location)
        self.high_traffic_area = Object("high_traffic_area", self.Location)
        self.snack = Object("snack", self.ObjectType)
        self.secure_container = Object("secure_container", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.snack_secured = Fluent("snack_secured", BoolType())
        self.visited_cluttered = Fluent("visited_cluttered", BoolType())
        self.visited_high_traffic = Fluent("visited_high_traffic", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_childs_room = Fluent("setting_is_childs_room", BoolType())
        self.room_has_small_objects = Fluent("room_has_small_objects", BoolType())
        self.room_has_electronics = Fluent("room_has_electronics", BoolType())
        self.room_has_high_traffic_areas = Fluent("room_has_high_traffic_areas", BoolType())
        self.room_has_cluttered_areas = Fluent("room_has_cluttered_areas", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.snack_secured, self.visited_cluttered, self.visited_high_traffic]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_childs_room, self.room_has_small_objects, self.room_has_electronics, self.room_has_high_traffic_areas, self.room_has_cluttered_areas]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.desk, self.bed, self.container_storage, self.cluttered_area, self.high_traffic_area, self.snack, self.secure_container]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_desk = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_desk")
        navigate_to_desk.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.desk)))
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.container_storage), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cluttered_area), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.high_traffic_area), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)

        navigate_to_bed = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bed")
        navigate_to_bed.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bed)))
        navigate_to_bed.add_precondition(Or(self.visited_cluttered, self.visited_high_traffic, self.snack_secured))
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.container_storage), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cluttered_area), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.high_traffic_area), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), True)
        
        navigate_to_container_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_container_storage")
        navigate_to_container_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.container_storage)))
        navigate_to_container_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_container_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), False)
        navigate_to_container_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cluttered_area), False)
        navigate_to_container_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.high_traffic_area), False)
        navigate_to_container_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.container_storage), True)

        navigate_to_cluttered_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cluttered_area")
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cluttered_area)))
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), False)
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.container_storage), False)
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.high_traffic_area), False)
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cluttered_area), True)
        navigate_to_cluttered_area.add_effect(self.visited_cluttered, True)

        navigate_to_high_traffic_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_high_traffic_area")
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.high_traffic_area)))
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bed), False)
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.container_storage), False)
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cluttered_area), False)
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.high_traffic_area), True)
        navigate_to_high_traffic_area.add_effect(self.visited_high_traffic, True)

        get_container = InstantaneousAction("get_container")
        get_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.container_storage))
        get_container.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.secure_container, self.container_storage))
        get_container.add_effect(self.object_at(self.secure_container, self.container_storage), False)
        get_container.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.secure_container), True)

        secure_snack = InstantaneousAction("secure_snack")
        secure_snack.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.secure_container))
        secure_snack.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.snack))
        secure_snack.add_precondition(Not(self.snack_secured))
        secure_snack.add_effect(self.snack_secured, True)

        grab_snack = InstantaneousAction("grab_snack")
        grab_snack.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        grab_snack.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.snack, self.desk))
        grab_snack.add_effect(self.object_at(self.snack, self.desk), False)
        grab_snack.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.snack), True)

        place_snack = InstantaneousAction("place_snack", at=self.Location)
        at = place_snack.parameter("at")
        place_snack.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_snack.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.snack))
        place_snack.add_effect(self.object_at(self.snack, at), True)
        place_snack.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.snack), False)

        return navigate_to_desk, navigate_to_bed, navigate_to_container_storage, navigate_to_cluttered_area, navigate_to_high_traffic_area, get_container, secure_snack, grab_snack, place_snack

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_cluttered_area": And([
                self.robot_has(self.snack),
                Not(self.snack_secured),
                self.room_has_cluttered_areas
            ]),
            "navigate_to_high_traffic_area": And([
                self.robot_has(self.snack),
                Not(self.snack_secured),
                self.room_has_high_traffic_areas
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.snack, self.desk), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.secure_container, self.container_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_childs_room, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.room_has_small_objects, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.room_has_electronics, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.room_has_high_traffic_areas, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.room_has_cluttered_areas, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.visited_cluttered, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.visited_high_traffic, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.snack, self.bed))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Banquet Hall Security
    
    This domain models a security robot verifying identification documents at a banquet hall entrance.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.PersonType = UserType("PersonType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.entrance = Object("entrance", self.Location)
        self.checkpoint = Object("checkpoint", self.Location)
        self.inside_area = Object("inside_area", self.Location)
        self.person1 = Object("person1", self.PersonType)
        self.person2 = Object("person2", self.PersonType)
        self.person3 = Object("person3", self.PersonType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.person_at = Fluent("person_at", BoolType(), person=self.PersonType, position=self.Location)
        self.id_checked = Fluent("id_checked", BoolType(), person=self.PersonType)
        self.person_processed = Fluent("person_processed", BoolType(), person=self.PersonType)
        self.people_waiting = Fluent("people_waiting", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_banquet_hall = Fluent("setting_is_banquet_hall", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_id_scanner = Fluent("robot_has_id_scanner", BoolType())
        self.sequential_processing_required = Fluent("sequential_processing_required", BoolType())
        self.congestion_possible = Fluent("congestion_possible", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.person_at, self.id_checked, self.person_processed, self.people_waiting]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_banquet_hall, self.robot_has_id_scanner, self.sequential_processing_required, self.congestion_possible]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.entrance, self.checkpoint, self.inside_area, self.person1, self.person2, self.person3]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_entrance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_entrance")
        navigate_to_entrance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.entrance)))
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkpoint), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inside_area), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), True)
        
        navigate_to_checkpoint = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_checkpoint")
        navigate_to_checkpoint.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.checkpoint)))
        navigate_to_checkpoint.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), False)
        navigate_to_checkpoint.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inside_area), False)
        navigate_to_checkpoint.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkpoint), True)
        
        navigate_to_inside_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_inside_area")
        navigate_to_inside_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.inside_area)))
        navigate_to_inside_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), False)
        navigate_to_inside_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkpoint), False)
        navigate_to_inside_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inside_area), True)

        # Check ID action - robot performs ID verification
        check_id = InstantaneousAction("check_id", person=self.PersonType)
        person = check_id.parameter("person")
        check_id.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkpoint))
        check_id.add_precondition(self.person_at(person, self.checkpoint))
        check_id.add_precondition(Not(self.id_checked(person)))
        check_id.add_effect(self.id_checked(person), True)

        # Process person action - robot allows person to enter after ID check
        process_person = InstantaneousAction("process_person", person=self.PersonType)
        person = process_person.parameter("person")
        process_person.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkpoint))
        process_person.add_precondition(self.person_at(person, self.checkpoint))
        process_person.add_precondition(self.id_checked(person))
        process_person.add_precondition(Not(self.person_processed(person)))
        process_person.add_effect(self.person_processed(person), True)
        process_person.add_effect(self.person_at(person, self.checkpoint), False)
        process_person.add_effect(self.person_at(person, self.inside_area), True)

        # Move person to checkpoint action
        move_to_checkpoint = InstantaneousAction("move_to_checkpoint", person=self.PersonType)
        person = move_to_checkpoint.parameter("person")
        move_to_checkpoint.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.entrance))
        move_to_checkpoint.add_precondition(self.person_at(person, self.entrance))
        move_to_checkpoint.add_effect(self.person_at(person, self.entrance), False)
        move_to_checkpoint.add_effect(self.person_at(person, self.checkpoint), True)
        move_to_checkpoint.add_effect(self.people_waiting, True)

        # Clear waiting status action
        clear_waiting_status = InstantaneousAction("clear_waiting_status")
        clear_waiting_status.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.entrance))
        clear_waiting_status.add_precondition(Not(self.person_at(self.person1, self.entrance)))
        clear_waiting_status.add_precondition(Not(self.person_at(self.person2, self.entrance)))
        clear_waiting_status.add_precondition(Not(self.person_at(self.person3, self.entrance)))
        clear_waiting_status.add_effect(self.people_waiting, False)

        return navigate_to_entrance, navigate_to_checkpoint, navigate_to_inside_area, check_id, process_person, move_to_checkpoint, clear_waiting_status

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "process_person": And([
                self.sequential_processing_required,  # Sequential processing is required
                self.congestion_possible,  # Congestion is possible
                self.people_waiting  # There are still people waiting at entrance
            ]),  # Processing people while others wait at entrance causes procedural inefficiency
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.person_at(self.person1, self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.person_at(self.person2, self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.person_at(self.person3, self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.people_waiting, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sequential_processing_required, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.congestion_possible, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_id_scanner, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.person_processed(self.person1))
        problem.add_goal(self.person_processed(self.person2))
        problem.add_goal(self.person_processed(self.person3))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
