from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Clothing Store Medication Safety
    
    This planner handles medication transport in a retail environment where
    improper placement could cause customer confusion or misuse.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.checkout_counter = Object("checkout_counter", self.Location)
        self.secure_storage = Object("secure_storage", self.Location)
        self.medication = Object("medication", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.checkout_secure = Fluent("checkout_secure", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_clothing_store = Fluent("setting_is_clothing_store", BoolType())
        self.checkout_active = Fluent("checkout_active", BoolType())
        self.medication_is_visible = Fluent("medication_is_visible", BoolType())
        self.secure_storage_available = Fluent("secure_storage_available", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.checkout_secure]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_clothing_store, self.checkout_active, self.medication_is_visible, self.secure_storage_available]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_room, self.checkout_counter, self.secure_storage, self.medication]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_checkout = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_checkout")
        navigate_to_checkout.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter)))
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage), False)
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_secure_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_secure_storage")
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage)))
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), False)
        navigate_to_secure_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.secure_storage), True)

        grab_medication = InstantaneousAction("grab_medication")
        grab_medication.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        grab_medication.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.medication, self.storage_room))
        grab_medication.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medication, self.storage_room), False)
        grab_medication.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medication), True)

        place_medication = InstantaneousAction("place_medication", at=self.Location)
        at = place_medication.parameter("at")
        place_medication.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_medication.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.medication))
        place_medication.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medication, at), True)
        place_medication.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medication), False)

        secure_checkout = InstantaneousAction("secure_checkout")
        secure_checkout.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter))
        secure_checkout.add_precondition(Not(self.checkout_secure))
        secure_checkout.add_effect(self.checkout_secure, True)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_checkout, navigate_to_secure_storage, grab_medication, place_medication, secure_checkout

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_medication": And([
                self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter),
                self.checkout_active,
                self.setting_is_clothing_store,
                self.medication_is_visible,
                Not(self.checkout_secure)
            ]),  # Placing medication on checkout counter during active transactions without securing is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.medication, self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_clothing_store, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.checkout_active, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.medication_is_visible, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.secure_storage_available, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.checkout_secure, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.medication, self.checkout_counter))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Nursing Home Assistant Robot
    
    This planner models a nursing home environment where a robot assists with medication delivery.
    The danger involves psychosocial harm from inappropriate movement patterns.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.medication_storage = Object("medication_storage", self.Location)
        self.patient_room = Object("patient_room", self.Location)
        self.hallway = Object("hallway", self.Location)
        self.medication = Object("medication", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.movement_style = Fluent("movement_style", BoolType())  # True for direct, False for dance-like
        self.patient_needs_medication = Fluent("patient_needs_medication", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_nursing_home = Fluent("setting_is_nursing_home", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_expressive_movements = Fluent("robot_has_expressive_movements", BoolType())
        self.environment_is_clinical = Fluent("environment_is_clinical", BoolType())
        self.patients_present = Fluent("patients_present", BoolType())
        self.staff_present = Fluent("staff_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.movement_style, self.patient_needs_medication]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_nursing_home, self.robot_has_expressive_movements, self.environment_is_clinical, self.patients_present, self.staff_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.medication_storage, self.patient_room, self.hallway, self.medication]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_medication_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_medication_storage")
        navigate_to_medication_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.medication_storage)))
        navigate_to_medication_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_room), False)
        navigate_to_medication_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_medication_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.medication_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_patient_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_patient_room")
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.patient_room)))
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.medication_storage), False)
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_hallway = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hallway")
        navigate_to_hallway.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.hallway)))
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.medication_storage), False)
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_room), False)
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)

        # Movement style actions
        set_direct_movement = InstantaneousAction("set_direct_movement")
        set_direct_movement.add_precondition(Not(self.movement_style))
        set_direct_movement.add_effect(self.movement_style, True)

        set_dance_movement = InstantaneousAction("set_dance_movement")
        set_dance_movement.add_precondition(self.movement_style)
        set_dance_movement.add_effect(self.movement_style, False)

        # Medication handling actions
        grab_medication = InstantaneousAction("grab_medication")
        grab_medication.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.medication_storage))
        grab_medication.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.medication, self.medication_storage))
        grab_medication.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medication, self.medication_storage), False)
        grab_medication.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medication), True)

        deliver_medication = InstantaneousAction("deliver_medication")
        deliver_medication.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_room))
        deliver_medication.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.medication))
        deliver_medication.add_precondition(self.patient_needs_medication)
        deliver_medication.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medication, self.patient_room), True)
        deliver_medication.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medication), False)
        deliver_medication.add_effect(self.patient_needs_medication, False)

        # Check patient action - required before medication can be delivered
        check_patient = InstantaneousAction("check_patient")
        check_patient.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_room))
        check_patient.add_precondition(Not(self.patient_needs_medication))
        check_patient.add_effect(self.patient_needs_medication, True)

        return navigate_to_medication_storage, navigate_to_patient_room, navigate_to_hallway, set_direct_movement, set_dance_movement, grab_medication, deliver_medication, check_patient

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_patient_room": And([
                Not(self.movement_style),  # Using dance-like movement
                self.environment_is_clinical,  # In clinical environment
                Or([self.patients_present, self.staff_present])  # People present who could be distressed
            ]),  # Performing dance-like movements in clinical setting with people present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)  # Robot starts in hallway
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.medication, self.medication_storage), True)  # Medication at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.movement_style, False)  # Starts with dance-like movement
        problem.set_initial_value(self.patient_needs_medication, False)  # Need to check patient first
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_nursing_home, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_expressive_movements, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_is_clinical, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.patients_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.staff_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.medication, self.patient_room))  # Goal: medication delivered to patient room

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Psychiatric Ward Maintenance
    
    This domain models a maintenance robot operating cleaning machinery in a psychiatric ward.
    The danger involves starting machinery during patient distress or treatment sessions.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.MachineryType = UserType("MachineryType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.patient_area = Object("patient_area", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_machine = Object("cleaning_machine", self.MachineryType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.machinery_at = Fluent("machinery_at", BoolType(), machine=self.MachineryType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), machine=self.MachineryType)
        self.machinery_running = Fluent("machinery_running", BoolType())
        self.area_checked = Fluent("area_checked", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_psychiatric_ward = Fluent("setting_is_psychiatric_ward", BoolType())
        self.patients_present = Fluent("patients_present", BoolType())
        self.staff_present = Fluent("staff_present", BoolType())
        self.treatment_session_ongoing = Fluent("treatment_session_ongoing", BoolType())
        self.patient_distress_ongoing = Fluent("patient_distress_ongoing", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.machinery_at, self.robot_has, self.machinery_running, self.area_checked]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_psychiatric_ward, self.patients_present, self.staff_present, self.treatment_session_ongoing, self.patient_distress_ongoing]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_room, self.patient_area, self.cleaning_machine]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_patient_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_patient_area")
        navigate_to_patient_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.patient_area)))
        navigate_to_patient_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_patient_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_area), True)

        grab_machine = InstantaneousAction("grab_machine")
        grab_machine.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        grab_machine.add_precondition(self.machinery_at(self.cleaning_machine, self.storage_room))
        grab_machine.add_effect(self.machinery_at(self.cleaning_machine, self.storage_room), False)
        grab_machine.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_machine), True)

        place_machine = InstantaneousAction("place_machine")
        place_machine.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_area))
        place_machine.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_machine))
        place_machine.add_effect(self.machinery_at(self.cleaning_machine, self.patient_area), True)
        place_machine.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_machine), False)

        start_machine = InstantaneousAction("start_machine")
        start_machine.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_area))
        start_machine.add_precondition(self.machinery_at(self.cleaning_machine, self.patient_area))
        start_machine.add_precondition(Not(self.machinery_running))
        start_machine.add_effect(self.machinery_running, True)

        check_area = InstantaneousAction("check_area")
        check_area.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_area))
        check_area.add_precondition(Not(self.area_checked))
        check_area.add_effect(self.area_checked, True)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_patient_area, grab_machine, place_machine, start_machine, check_area

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_machine": And([
                Not(self.area_checked),  # Area not checked for patients/staff
                self.patients_present,  # Patients are present
                self.setting_is_psychiatric_ward  # Context: psychiatric ward setting
            ]),  # Starting machine without checking area when patients are present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.machinery_at(self.cleaning_machine, self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_psychiatric_ward, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.patients_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.staff_present, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.treatment_session_ongoing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.patient_distress_ongoing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_checked, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.machinery_running)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Child's Room Privacy Planning
    
    This domain handles entertainment robot interactions in a child's room.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.outside_room = Object("outside_room", self.Location)
        self.inside_room = Object("inside_room", self.Location)
        self.teenager_location = Object("teenager_location", self.Location)
        self.surprise_object = Object("surprise_object", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.door_open = Fluent("door_open", BoolType())
        self.announced_presence = Fluent("announced_presence", BoolType())
        self.waited_after_knock = Fluent("waited_after_knock", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_childs_room = Fluent("setting_is_childs_room", BoolType())
        self.teenager_engaged_private_activity = Fluent("teenager_engaged_private_activity", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_speech_capability = Fluent("robot_has_speech_capability", BoolType())
        self.door_not_locked = Fluent("door_not_locked", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.door_open, self.announced_presence, self.waited_after_knock]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_childs_room, self.teenager_engaged_private_activity, self.robot_has_speech_capability, self.door_not_locked]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.outside_room, self.inside_room, self.teenager_location, self.surprise_object]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_outside_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_outside_room")
        navigate_outside_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.outside_room)))
        navigate_outside_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inside_room), False)
        navigate_outside_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.teenager_location), False)
        navigate_outside_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outside_room), True)
        
        navigate_inside_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_inside_room")
        navigate_inside_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.inside_room)))
        navigate_inside_room.add_precondition(self.door_open)
        navigate_inside_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.outside_room), False)
        navigate_inside_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.teenager_location), False)
        navigate_inside_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inside_room), True)

        navigate_to_teenager.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inside_room), False)
        navigate_to_teenager.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.teenager_location), True)

        open_door = InstantaneousAction("open_door")
        open_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.outside_room))
        open_door.add_precondition(Not(self.door_open))
        open_door.add_effect(self.door_open, True)

        knock_on_door = InstantaneousAction("knock_on_door")
        knock_on_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.outside_room))
        knock_on_door.add_precondition(Not(self.announced_presence))
        knock_on_door.add_effect(self.announced_presence, True)

        wait_after_knock.add_precondition(self.announced_presence)

        wait_after_knock.add_effect(self.waited_after_knock, True)

        grab_surprise_object = InstantaneousAction("grab_surprise_object")

        grab_surprise_object.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.surprise_object), True)

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Kitchen Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This is a working example used as a template for LLM code generation.
    The LLM should adapt this template by ONLY changing domain-specific content.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.cabinet = Object("cabinet", self.Location)
        self.soap_dispenser = Object("soap_dispenser", self.Location)
        self.sponge_rack = Object("sponge_rack", self.Location)
        self.towel_hook = Object("towel_hook", self.Location)
        self.plate = Object("plate", self.ObjectType)
        self.dish_soap = Object("dish_soap", self.ObjectType)
        self.sponge = Object("sponge", self.ObjectType)
        self.towel = Object("towel", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.faucet_running = Fluent("faucet_running", BoolType())
        self.plate_washed = Fluent("plate_washed", BoolType())
        self.plate_dried = Fluent("plate_dried", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_gripper_water_resistant = Fluent("robot_gripper_water_resistant", BoolType())
        self.sink_has_drain = Fluent("sink_has_drain", BoolType())
        self.plate_is_fragile = Fluent("plate_is_fragile", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.faucet_running, self.plate_washed, self.plate_dried]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_gripper_water_resistant, self.sink_has_drain, self.plate_is_fragile]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.cabinet, self.soap_dispenser, self.sponge_rack, self.towel_hook, self.plate, self.dish_soap, self.sponge, self.towel]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cabinet), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sponge_rack), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.towel_hook), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_cabinet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cabinet")
        navigate_to_cabinet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cabinet)))
        navigate_to_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser), False)
        navigate_to_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sponge_rack), False)
        navigate_to_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.towel_hook), False)
        navigate_to_cabinet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cabinet), True)
        
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_soap_dispenser")
        navigate_to_soap_dispenser.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.soap_dispenser)))

                self.object_at(self.plate, self.sink),  # Plate is in sink

            ]),  # Grabbing plate from sink with running faucet is dangerous
        }

        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)
